headline: Identified a new 925-student school at Sycamore Street as the preferred option, and accepted FY26 and FY27 grant funds by an 8-0 vote.
summary: The meeting covered the MSBA school project, including parking, costs, and pre-K space. Option 4, a new 925-student school at Sycamore Street, was identified as the preferred schematic direction. The committee also accepted FY26 and FY27 grant funds by a roll call vote of 8-0.
decisions: Identified Option 4, a new 925-student school at Sycamore Street, as the preferred schematic direction.
Approved accepting all federal entitlement and continuation grants and all state continuation grants awarded to the Somerville Public Schools, by a roll call vote of 8-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Option 4, a new 925-student school at Sycamore Street, was identified as the preferred schematic direction.

MOTION: There was a motion by SC Rep Biton Lippens, seconded by SC Rep Pitone,to accept all federal entitlement and continuation grants and all state continuation grants awarded to the Somerville Public Schools listed below: ... Motion passed Yes: 8 No: 0, unanimously.
